# Backtracking exact cover over all mask cells and pieces, respecting one use per source component.
cell_list=sorted(mask); cellid={p:i for i,p in enumerate(cell_list)}
allmask=(1<<len(cell_list))-1
pcands=[]
for i,pls in enumerate(cands):
  arr=[]
  for cells,r,c,ori in pls:
    bits=0
    for p in cells: bits|=1<<cellid[p]
    arr.append((bits,r,c,ori))
  pcands.append(arr)
# index candidate placements by cell and piece
bycell=[[] for _ in cell_list]
for i,arr in enumerate(pcands):
 for j,pl in enumerate(arr):
  bits=pl[0]
  for b in range(len(cell_list)):
   if bits>>b&1: bycell[b].append((i,j))
# remove identical shapes symmetry somewhat by impose same-shape pieces candidate index order after placements later
nodes=0; answer=None

def search(covered, used, chosen):
 global nodes,answer
 nodes+=1
 if covered==allmask:
  if used==(1<<len(pieces))-1:
   answer=chosen.copy(); return True
  return False
 # choose uncovered cell with fewest eligible placements, accounting piece unused/no overlap
 bestopts=None
 rem=allmask^covered
 while rem:
  bit=rem & -rem; b=bit.bit_length()-1; rem-=bit
  opts=[]
  for i,j in bycell[b]:
   if used>>i&1: continue
   bits,r,c,ori=pcands[i][j]
   if bits&covered==0: opts.append((i,j))
  if bestopts is None or len(opts)<len(bestopts):
   bestopts=opts
   if len(opts)<=1: break
 if not bestopts: return False
 # Try larger pieces first, then order by placement r,c
 bestopts.sort(key=lambda ij:(-len(pcands[ij[0]][ij[1]][3])*len(pcands[ij[0]][ij[1]][3][0]),ij[0],pcands[ij[0]][ij[1]][1],pcands[ij[0]][ij[1]][2]))
 for i,j in bestopts:
  bits,r,c,ori=pcands[i][j]
  chosen.append((i,r,c,ori,bits))
  if search(covered|bits,used|(1<<i),chosen): return True
  chosen.pop()
 return False
found=search(0,0,[])
found,nodes,[(i,(r,c),ori) for i,r,c,ori,_ in answer] if answer else None
